question: M men agree to purchase a gift for Rs. D. If 3 men drop out how much more will each have to contribute towards the purchase of the gift?
explain:
Initial contribution = D/m
After 3 men drop out, then the contribution = D/M-3
the extra amount to pay = (D/m-3)-D/m
=D(m-m+3)/)(m^2-3*m)
= 3D/(m^2-3*m)

question: In a factory, an average of 60 TV's are produced per day for the fist 25days of the months. A few workers fell ill for the next 5days reducing the daily avg for the month to 58 sets/day . The average production per day for day last 5days is ?
explain:
Production during these 5 days = Total production in a month - production in first 25 days.
= 30 x 58 - 25 x 60
= 240
∴ Average for last 5 days = 240 / 5
= 48

A train is running at a speed of 40 km/hr and it crosses a post in 18 seconds. What is the length of the train?
explain:
Explanation:
Speed of the train, v = 40 km/hr = 40000/3600 m/s = 400/36 m/s
Time taken to cross, t = 18 s
Distance Covered, d = vt = (400/36)× 18 = 200 m
Distance covered is equal to the length of the train = 200 m

question: Jegan has 10 pairs of shoes; each pair is a different color. If Jegan randomly selects 2 shoes without replacement from the 20 shoes, what is the probability that she will select 2 shoes of the same color?
explain:
Can be tackled in this way as well: Probability of selecting any 1 out of 20 shoes = 20/20 = 1
Probability of selecting the next shoe (out of 19 available) having the same color = 1/19 (as after selecting the 1st one, there is only 1 another shoe left with the same color).
Thus the total probability = 1*1/19=1/19.
E is the correct answer.

question: A can give B 300 meters start and C 600 meters start in a kilometer race. How much start can B give C in a kilometer race?
explain:
A runs 1000 m while B runs 700 m and C runs 400 m.
The number of meters that C runs when B runs 1000 m,
= (1000 * 400)/700 = 571.43 m.
B can give C = 1000 - 571.43 = 428.57 m.
